arabic text: UMMAT NE FATEMA KO RONE NAHI DIYA HAI\nKHATME RUSUL KE SAATH YE BHALA KON SI WAFA\nHAI
english translation text: The nation did not allow Fatima to\nweep; what kind of loyalty was\nthis towards the Seal of the Messengers?

arabic text: ASHAABA MEIN BABA KE RAHI KHUTBE SUNATI YEH\nAUR SANAD KE TUKDRON KO ROTE HUWE CHUNA HAI
english translation text: Among her father's companions she continued to deliver sermons,\nand weeping, she gathered the torn pieces of her document.

arabic text: KEHTE THE RAAT KO RO YA DIN KO BAHAA ANSU\nBAGHE FIDAK UNHON NE, BHI CHIN LIYA HAI
english translation text: They said: weep at night, or shed your tears during the day;\nyet they also seized the garden of Fadak from her.

arabic text: AUR RASIYAN ALI KO PEHNAYI GAY THI JAB\nMERI BETION KO MANZAR YE BHI DEKHNA PARA HAI
english translation text: When ropes were placed around Ali,\nmy daughters were forced to witness that scene too.

arabic text: MIMBAR PE JO GHASIB THE MERE KHUTBE PE HANSTE\nTHE\nIS WASTE JANAZA MERA RAAT KO UTHA HAI
english translation text: Those usurpers upon the pulpit laughed\nat my sermon; that is why\nmy funeral was carried at night.

arabic text: ROTI THI KHARI ZAHRA HASTE RAHE SAHABI\nYEH ZULM BARA KYUN KAR UJRI PE TAB HUWA HAI
english translation text: Zahra stood weeping, while the companions continued to laugh;\nwhy was such immense oppression committed against the devastated lady?

arabic text: KAHAAN BETI MOHAMED KI KAHAAN TAKHT\nNASHEEN ZALIM\nROTE HUWE AKTHER NE IS NOHE KO LIKHA HAI
english translation text: Where is Muhammad's daughter, and where\nis the tyrant seated upon the\nthrone? Weeping, "Akhtar" wrote this lament.
